    .pp-thunder{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:50px auto;opacity:0;transition:opacity 0.4s;}
    .pp-thunder svg{width:88px;height:84px;}
    .pp-thunder--visible{opacity:1;}
    .pp-thunder svg{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(4);opacity:0.25;transition:filter 0.4s,opacity 0.4s;}
    .pp-thunder--neon svg{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #E157E7) drop-shadow(0 0 20px #9b59ff) drop-shadow(0 0 40px #7b2fff);opacity:1;}
    @keyframes pp-thunder-blink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}45%{opacity:0.08;}55%{opacity:0.08;}70%{opacity:1;}80%{opacity:0.3;}90%{opacity:1;}}
    .pp-thunder--blinking{animation:pp-thunder-blink 0.5s steps(1,end) 1 forwards;}
    .pp-section{padding:32px 32px;text-align:center;}
    .pp-section--alt{background:#0b0b0b;}
    .pp-section__eyebrow{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.4);margin-bottom:16px;}
    .pp-section__title{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25;}
    .pp-section__body{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:#fff;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:32px;}
    .pp-cards{display:flex;flex-direction:row;margin-top:32px;}
    .pp-cards .pp-card{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;margin-right:16px;}
    .pp-card{background:#1a1a24;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);border-radius:8px;padding:24px;}
    .pp-card__title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;}
    .pp-card__body{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);}
    .pp-stat{text-align:center;margin:32px 0;}
    .pp-stat__number{font-size:56px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;line-height:1;}
    .pp-stat__label{font-size:14px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.5);margin-top:8px;}
    .pp-pillars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:24px;}
    .pp-pillar{background:transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:20px 24px;text-align:left;}
    .pp-pillar__icon{display:block;width:56px;height:56px;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px #E157E7) drop-shadow(0 0 20px #9b59ff) drop-shadow(0 0 40px #7b2fff);}
    .pp-pillar__title{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:#fff;}
    .pp-pillar__body{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:#fff;}
    .pp-goals{display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:24px;}
    .pp-goal{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:24px;}
    .pp-goal__num{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.15);flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;margin-right:20px;}
    .pp-goal__title{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;}
    .pp-goal__body{font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);}
    .pp-quotes{display:flex;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:820px;margin:50px auto 0;}
    .pp-quote-col{width:50%;padding:0 20px 32px;box-sizing:border-box;}
    .pp-quote{font-size:14px;padding:16px 16px 16px 90px;color:#f8fafc;line-height:1.625;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);border-radius:8px;position:relative;}
    .pp-quote__cover{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:90px;pointer-events:none;margin-left:-22px;margin-top:-16px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);}
    .pp-quote__text{font-style:normal;margin:0;text-align:left;}
    .pp-quote__author{display:block;margin-top:12px;color:#cbd5e1;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;}
    .pp-footer{position:relative;margin-top:-50px;background:transparent;padding:16px 24px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;overflow:visible;flex-shrink:0;width:100%;border-radius:0 0 16px 16px;}
    .pp-footer__glow{position:absolute;bottom:-50px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:820px;height:200px;border-radius:100%;background:rgb(0 0 0);filter:blur(50px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}
    .pp-btn-primary{position:relative;z-index:1;margin:0 6px;overflow:hidden;background:#9dd630;color:#1a3d00;border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:17px 34px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Lato',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(157,214,48,0);transition:background 0.2s,box-shadow 0.3s;}
    .pp-btn-primary::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-80%;width:60%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 0%,rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 50%,transparent 100%);transform:skewX(-20deg);transition:none;pointer-events:none;}
    .pp-btn-primary:hover::after{animation:pp-btn-shine 0.6s ease forwards;}
    @keyframes pp-btn-shine{0%{left:-80%;}100%{left:130%;}}
    .pp-btn-primary:hover{background:#8bc22a;animation:pp-btn-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;}
    @keyframes pp-btn-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 20px 8px rgba(157,214,48,0.07),0 0 50px 16px rgba(157,214,48,0.04);}50%{box-shadow:0 0 30px 12px rgba(157,214,48,0.12),0 0 70px 24px rgba(157,214,48,0.06);}}
    .pp-btn-outline{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;margin:0 6px;color:#fff;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6);border-radius:4px;padding:14px 34px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Lato',sans-serif;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration: none;}
    .pp-btn-outline::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:-80%;width:60%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 0%,rgba(255,255,255,0.3) 50%,transparent 100%);transform:skewX(-20deg);pointer-events:none;}
    .pp-btn-outline:hover{border-color:#fff;}
    .pp-btn-outline:hover::after{animation:pp-btn-shine 0.6s ease forwards;}
    @media(max-width:600px){
      .pp-stats{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
      .pp-stat-col{margin:0 0 24px 0;}
      .pp-features{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
      .pp-pillars{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
      .pp-quotes{flex-direction:column;}
      .pp-quote-col{width:100%;padding:0 0 24px 0;}
      .pp-footer{flex-direction:column;}
      .pp-btn-primary,.pp-btn-outline{margin:6px 0;width:100%;text-align:center;}
      .pp-marquee{width:200px !important;}
      .pp-modal__close{top:-40px;right:50%;transform:scale(1.5) translateX(50%);}
      .pp-feature__img{max-width:240px;}
    }
